source.evidence: Current clean pushed main online print gate, exact retained-mesh/profile comparison and 74 finite toolpath sections reviewed. Not uploaded or started. Current task6370 must finish; fresh bed, runtime material/mapping and identical upload readback required.

notes: Seven needed first-machine prototype pieces. 8h11m17s /136.05g are slicer estimates, not measured usage. Black PLA Basic, right 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.15mm layers (0.20 first), 3 walls,15% infill, 5 mm outer brims,220C nozzle/55C texturedPEI, supports off. Grinder cap bridge_angle90 is explicit and compared in editable/slice metadata. Exact jobName is a proposed unique name, not accepted printer identity. No native slicer bitmap; both preview fields show exact first-layer GCode plot. Cleanup, fit, strength and function are unverified. Upstream HdM Project ENIGMA R.D.E., Prof. Dr. Simon Wiest, revision397ca89, CC BY-NC-SA4.0. Revalidated from current main b652c92d on 17 November. Owner reserves manual start 21:00–22:00Europe/Oslo on 17 November; slicer-estimated finish05:11–06:11 on18November, deadline07:00. File prepared on M4 and mini; attempted legacy FTPS upload rejected553. Target file confirmed absent, not retried; official-transfer probe could not connect. Not uploaded or started. Storage transfer/readback, current-job terminal, bed clearance and live black-PLA/material/nozzle mapping checks remain required. Superseded while still planned by the ten-piece overnight selection on 17 November. This seven-piece proposal was never accepted or started by the printer; cancelled is a planning status here, not a physical failed/cancelled print. Retained for history.
